notes.content: Foundation landed in new crate outram-foam-multiphase (commit e5697b8): DriftFluxMixture (mixture rho/mu), SlipModel enum (Zuber-Findlay/terminal-velocity/user-defined), advance_alpha void-fraction transport. description: kovan-discovery's CommitInfo carries only 'summary' (first line). Trailer parsing needs the FULL message body, plus the author-date ISO string. Extend CommitInfo with a body field (and author date) in kovan-discovery rather than writing a second git layer -- update its doc comments and any existing call sites. Then implement parse_trailer: locate the '^API-Usage-Since-Last-Commit:\s*(.+)$' line (MULTILINE) and split the remainder on whitespace into key=value pairs. Unit-test against real commit bodies from this repo, including commits with no trailer and with source=none.
title: kovan-metrics: commit body + trailer parsing
